styleGuide: Use casual, friendly tone with だ/である体 for narration, but switch to です/ます体 for direct address to viewer.
Keep sentences short and natural for subtitle reading speed.
Translate technical terms consistently using the glossary; avoid English loanwords where natural Japanese exists.
For humor, use colloquial expressions like やばい, すごい, マジで.
When explaining, use 〜というわけだ or 〜ってこと to sound conversational.
Avoid overly formal or literal translations; prefer everyday spoken Japanese.
For proper nouns, keep original spelling in katakana (e.g., ロレックス, チューダー).
Use 〜てる/〜てる instead of 〜ている for casual speech.
For emphasis, use 〜んだよ or 〜んですよ.
When quoting someone, use 〜って言ってた.
